rationale.metric: ROC AUC evaluates churn ranking performance effectively under class imbalance.
rationale.drop_columns: No high-cardinality IDs, datetime strings, or free-text columns are present in the dataset.
rationale.preprocessing: Median imputation preserves numerical robustly and one-hot encoding fits low cardinality categories.
rationale.feature_selection: Keep all features as the total feature dimension is small and informative.
rationale.model: Hist gradient boosting handles tabular nonlinear relationships and interactions well.
rationale.class_weight: Balanced class weighting compensates for the ~26% minority positive class.
